steps.en: A malformed notice number shows an error
steps.id: Nomor notice yang formatnya salah menampilkan error

steps.en: A malformed ID number shows an error
steps.id: Nomor ID yang formatnya salah menampilkan error

steps.en: A bad vehicle number is rejected
steps.why_en: Only checked when a registration type is chosen; otherwise anything passes.
steps.why_id: Hanya dicek jika tipe registrasi dipilih; kalau tidak, apa pun lolos.

steps.en: An empty search says there are no records
steps.why_en: Generic empty-grid text only; no message about furnishable notices.
steps.why_id: Hanya teks grid kosong umum; tidak ada pesan soal notice furnishable.

steps.en: A non-furnishable notice is rejected with a reason
steps.id: Notice yang tidak furnishable ditolak dengan alasan

steps.en: Paid or cancelled notices are refused
steps.why_en: No paid or cancelled check; only refused indirectly if already suspended or at a late stage.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada cek paid/cancelled; hanya tertolak tidak langsung jika sudah suspended atau stage lanjut.
